headline: OKX Bitcoin Spot Taker Flow Flips From A 262.124 Bitcoin Buy Imbalance To A 191.751 Bitcoin Sell Imbalance
narrative: OKX spot taker flow in bitcoin flipped to a 191.751 bitcoin sell imbalance over 24 hours, from a 262.124 bitcoin buy imbalance at the prior reading. The figure is aggressive buy volume minus aggressive sell volume on that venue's spot book, so the sign change means sellers hitting offers outpaced buyers lifting them by 191.751 bitcoin. That 24-hour window now sits at the 31.8th percentile of the last 30 days, down from the 80.2nd percentile, while the seven-day taker balance remains a 283.085 bitcoin buy surplus.
author: jordan
